text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
First of all, Happy New Year. Thank you 
very much for taking the time to come 
today.

text_block_list.name: Program Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
And now, we will begin the briefing for 
the URA's new special intensive program 
with an eye toward overseas campaigns— the 
"Overseas Expedition Program."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"With the Symboli and Mejiro families at 
the center, the URA will lead efforts to 
provide all-encompassing support for top 
domestic Umamusume"—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Their support for overseas campaigns in 
particular is generous—covering everything 
from finances to on-site assistance, 
training facilities, lodging, and dietary 
needs.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The track conditions and climate are 
completely different from Japan. On-site 
preparation is absolutely essential, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy only provides the bare 
minimum essentials.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Across the entire Umamusume world, there's 
practically no track record overseas. 
They're not gonna allocate a massive 
budget for something so risky.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"That's why if we can get support from the 
'Overseas Expedition Program', it'll make 
for a well-funded trip. Not a bad deal at 
all."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what was going on so suddenly 
right at the start of the New Year, but it 
turned out to be quite a fruitful 
endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even so, achieving suitable results is 
essential to be selected for the program.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You could say it all depends on this 
year's rotation. Get fired up, Trai—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year. Sirius, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I imagine it was an unexpected piece of 
good news for New Year's Day. I couldn't 
help thinking it would make you happy, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I am deeply honored— I 
simply cannot conceal my joy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"For now, this is mainly focused on our 
Symboli and the Mejiro families, but if it 
goes well, it will likely see widespread 
use."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Many girls dream of going overseas, but 
can't take the leap for various reasons. 
If only I could be of some help to them—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! As expected of the "Emperor," always 
caring for "them" anytime, anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You'd best watch yourself so that grand 
preaching of yours doesn't trip you up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right. I'll be careful.

Smiling wryly at her ever-combative 
attitude, I followed her out into the 
hallway. And then—

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see? Picking a fight with Symboli 
Rudolf... So the rumors are true."

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
She had quite a fierce look in her eyes. 
Rudolf-san is usually such a dignified 
person, so why...

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Could they be jealous of her skills? Word 
around the academy is she's leading 
delinquents or something...

Unable to simply ignore what I heard, I 
turned toward the kitchenette where the 
voices were coming from. However—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Wait. It's fine, leave it alone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter to me. It's not like this 
just started today, anyway.

"Since she was asking to let it drop, I 
wanted to avoid making a scene. I quietly 
headed home instead."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then, about today's training menu... 
Since it's a festive time of year, I'll 
give you a New Year's gift, puppy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, idiot. It's not about money. 
...As a special favor, I'll give ya the 
"right to choose."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as you've been a relatively good 
kid, fine. I'm only gonna say this once, 
so listen up, got it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Either "Weight Lifting", "Rest", or 
"Billiards".
choice_data_list: It's more diverse than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's a spot I wanna train with some 
lift work. Though, well, I've been pushing 
hard lately, so maybe I should just rest 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you the basics of billiards. I 
can't stand watching you stay terrible 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're quite enthusiastic yourself.

And so, we moved to the academy's training 
gym――

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Phew! ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... Not enough weight. Hey, add 
more.

We carried out intensive lift training 
until the sun went down.

A short while after the New Year holidays 
ended, a new notice arrived from the URA.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If you're gonna rest, make 
sure you rest properly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare do something stupid like 
fooling around just because you've got 
time off.

Come to think of it, couldn't I take 
advantage of this day off to hang out with 
Sirius Symboli and deepen our bond...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, you're not thinkin' about 
something stupid, are you?"

Afterward, I tried inviting her out to 
hang out, but got shot down hard— and so I 
spent a quiet New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after the New Year holidays 
ended, a new notice arrived from the URA.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Got some guts, don'tcha? If that's what 
you want, I'll whip ya into proper shape."
(—*clang!*)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Amateur. Take a closer look at how the 
balls are placed— that's not the shot you 
should be aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Above all, you're too tense. You've got 
unnecessary tension in your shoulders... 
Here, let me.

"Thanks to her harsh yet accurate 
instruction, my billiards skills improved 
just a little."

A short while after the New Year holidays 
ended, a new notice arrived from the URA.

That the "Overseas Expedition Program" has 
begun. Its main focus is challenging the 
world, and the candidates are—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf, huh. Hmph, looking at the 
situation, it's a reasonable choice. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
choice_data_list: My chance will come around eventually.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Naturally. They're not blind, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"In any case, it's results that matter. 
I'm going to snatch up everything there is 
to take in this year's Classic circuit."

This year will be a decisive one. I want 
to sprint alongside her, aiming for 
greater heights!
